title: Bikewatching
description: An interactive Mapbox and D3 visualization of BlueBikes stations, bike lanes, and traffic flow in the Boston area.

title: SoCalGuessr: Street View City Classification
description: This project focuses on classifying cities from Google Street View images using deep learning, exploring how visual features and geographic similarities affect model performance.

title: Causal Reasoning Evaluation for LLMs
description: This project investigates whether large language models truly perform causal reasoning or rely on memorized knowledge, using controlled benchmarks and prompting strategies.

title: Insurance Fraud Prediction
description: This project analyzes patterns in insurance claims to identify fraudulent behavior, examining how different features contribute to predicting suspicious cases.

title: Clothing Fit Prediction
description: This project explores how customer data and product attributes can be used to predict clothing fit, highlighting the relationship between objective measurements and subjective feedback.

title: Recipe Preparation Time and Calorie Analysis
description: This project examines large-scale recipe data to understand the factors that influence calorie content, focusing on nutritional patterns and fairness across different types of recipes.

title: Language Modeling Project
description: This project explores how language models generate text, comparing different probabilistic approaches to understand how machines learn and produce natural language.

title: Multimedia Processing and Classification Suite
description: This project focuses on processing and analyzing image and audio data, combining signal processing techniques with machine learning for classification tasks.
